task.title: Keep sent messages visible during generation
task.source: Live Raspberry Pi mobile-browser user report

coreClaim: A newly sent user message remains continuously visible while its character response generates, even when an older chat-messages query finishes after the send begins.
rootCause: runGenerationWithUi inserted an optimistic user row without cancelling an already-running React Query messages request. On a slower mobile connection, the older request could finish afterward and replace the cache with a page captured before the new row existed. Later generation events upserted the saved rows and made the message reappear.

inScope: Exact chat-messages query cancellation before optimistic insertion
Post-merge Raspberry Pi deployment and health verification
outOfScope: Mobile layout or transcript rendering redesign

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Only a real outbound user send cancels the exact active chat-messages query before its optimistic row is inserted.
currentPathsOrFormats: Persisted user_message and assistant_message stream events
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not make provider generation faster.
This change does not alter persisted message records.
This change does not claim a live mobile-browser pass before the merged image is deployed.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: An older chat-messages request remained able to replace the cache after a newer optimistic outbound row was inserted.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Conversation, Roleplay, and Game transcript surfaces observing chatKeys.messages(chatId)
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Once a user send is represented optimistically, an obsolete request started before that send cannot remove it from the visible transcript.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: insertOptimisticUserMessage awaits queryClient.cancelQueries for the exact chat-messages key after confirming an optimistic row exists and before writing that row.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The shared frontend generation lifecycle owns coordination between stream state and the React Query transcript cache.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not add storage fallbacks, mobile CSS guards, a second pending-message store, or mode-specific patches for a shared cache race.
regressionProof: src/features/runtime/generation/hooks/use-generate.spec.ts keeps the optimistic user message when an older messages query finishes

positiveRows.claim: A stale messages query cannot remove the optimistic user row while generation is still blocked.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused test failed before the fix with only message-before-send in the cache, then passed after exact-query cancellation.

positiveRows.claim: The shared generation hook remains valid across its frontend dependency boundaries.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm check passed after the final formatted diff, including TypeScript, architecture, docs, Rust workspace, security, storage-contract, and workflow gates.

positiveRows.claim: The complete focused generation-hook suite remains green.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm exec vitest run src/features/runtime/generation/hooks/use-generate.spec.ts passed 19/19 tests.

contradictionRows.claim: Regenerate and impersonate must not gain a synthetic outbound user row or unnecessary query cancellation.
contradictionRows.evidence: optimisticUserMessage returns null for impersonate and regenerateMessageId before insertOptimisticUserMessage reaches cancelQueries.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not cancel queries for another chat.
contradictionRows.evidence: cancelQueries uses chatKeys.messages(args.chatId) with exact true.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not hide a failed persistence operation behind local UI state.
contradictionRows.evidence: The engine save and user_message event contract is unchanged; runGenerationWithUi retains its existing error and final refresh paths.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Continue, regenerate, and impersonate paths keep their existing non-optimistic behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The cancellation is inside insertOptimisticUserMessage after the null guard rather than unconditionally at generation start.

untestedRows: The merged image has not yet been exercised from the physical mobile browser; post-merge Pi deployment and health checks are part of the authorized shipping lane.

ownedFacts.description: The Pi was healthy and running checkout efcad32faf56eb94196b212bcb4dc39ab66e09ac when the bug was diagnosed.
ownedFacts.evidence: The Pi checkout, container age, and /health?probe=1 response were inspected before implementation.

ownedFacts.description: The user-message persistence event is emitted after saveUserMessage completes.
ownedFacts.evidence: src/engine/generation/start-generation.ts awaits saveUserMessage before yielding the user_message event.

manualBlockers.reason: The deterministic public-seam test proves the cache race and fix. The requested Pi deployment must complete before the exact device path can be tried.

verification.baselineEvidence: The focused test failed on the stale-query overwrite before the fix. After the fix and formatting, the 19-test use-generate suite, targeted Prettier check, git diff --check, and full pnpm check passed.
